issues.description: A single batched `findMany({ id: { in: orderIds } })` was replaced with a per-id `findUnique` inside a serial loop: an N+1 query pattern. For a report over hundreds of orders this issues hundreds of round-trips instead of one, and the awaits run serially so latency scales linearly with the input.

findUnique returns null for a missing id with no guard; toRow(order) at line 13 then crashes or pushes a corrupt row. The old batched findMany silently dropped missing ids — this is a behavior change, not just a perf swap.
